display.title: Lag BaOmer: The Day of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai's Joy
display.summary_short: Why Lag BaOmer, the yahrzeit of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, is a day of joy, celebrated with song and dance in Meron and with children's parades everywhere.
display.summary_long: A short Lag BaOmer talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, aired the week of the holiday. Uncle Yossi explains that this coming Sunday is Lag BaOmer, the yahrzeit of the great tzaddik Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, known as the Rashbi. On this day his soul returned to Hashem, and he told his students to celebrate it as a day of simcha, calling it 'the day of my joy'. In Eretz Yisroel, thousands of Jews gather at his resting place in Meron to say Tehillim and special prayers, sing and dance. Here too, Jewish children gather together and retell the many stories about Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai.
display.lesson: Lag BaOmer is a day of joy: celebrate it together and retell the stories of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai.

date.note: Cut from episode 124, aired the Tuesday before Lag BaOmer 5744 ('this coming Sunday').
